text.en:
recommendation of the Secretary of Finance, do hereby
remit the 50 per cent of the 1952 taxes on all real prop-
erties located in the Province of Mindoro Oriental on
condition that all the unpaid taxes and penalties corre-
sponding to 1951 and previous years and the remaining
50 per cent of the 1952 taxes shall be paid on or before
Done in the City of Manila, this 28th day of April,
in the vear of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and fifty-
three, and of the Independence of the Philippines, the
ELPIDIO QUIkINO
President of the Philippines
By the President:
•MARCIANO ROQUE
Acting Executive Secretary
